zh.summary: 改善 GitHub 限流或拒绝访问时的便携版与内核更新检查。
highlights: 当 GitHub 返回 403 或 429 时，Portable 和内核更新检查会尝试现有镜像，并验证镜像返回的更新清单签名。
更新页面会说明从哪个子目录选择 JSON，并提供手动下载指南。
upgradeNotes: Portable 与内核可分别更新。若当前版本无法联网检查，可在能联网的电脑下载同一更新的 JSON、签名和 ZIP，再在应用中选择从文件更新。
第三方插件若在 GitHub 源码安装时被 pnpm 拒绝，可使用维护者发布的 npm 包或 Release 的 .tgz。
acknowledgements: 感谢 #271 的报告者提供 Windows 更新和插件安装的反馈。

en.summary: Improves Portable and core update checks when GitHub denies or rate-limits requests.
highlights: If GitHub returns 403 or 429, Portable and core update checks try the existing mirrors and verify the signature on the returned update metadata.
The Updates page explains which folder contains the JSON and links to manual download instructions.
upgradeNotes: Portable and core update separately. If your current version cannot check online, download the matching JSON, signature and ZIP on a connected computer, then select Update from file.
If pnpm refuses to install a third-party plugin from GitHub source, use the maintainer's npm package or release .tgz.
acknowledgements: Thanks to the reporter of #271 for the Windows update and plugin installation feedback.
